To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FeynRules is the most comprehensive, robust and easy-to-use tool to implement any perturbative particle physics model in any supported event generator.

FeynRules allows for a fast and efficient implementation of any Lagrangian-based new physics model, and that the validation of the model is straightforward and can be performed with a few lines of code.

the FeynRules framework allows one to automatically pass any Lagrangian to any event generator, and that this is the most efficient way to implement and validate any new physics model in a Monte Carlo framework.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and validation of a framework for the simulation of any perturbative particle physics model.
the development of a complete, consistent and efficient simulation of new physics processes in the Standard Model and beyond.

the development and validation of the most general Feynman rules of any new physics Lagrangian and their automatic transfer to Monte Carlo event generators, which is a crucial step in the development of any new physics model and in the interpretation of any new physics search.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FeynRules framework provides an efficient and flexible tool for the implementation, validation and simulation of any new physics model.
the framework described above provides an efficient and flexible environment for any kind of new physics studies.
the framework is very flexible and powerful, and can be used to implement any new physics model, as long as the Lagrangian is known.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the user can now generate any new physics model in a fully automated and reliable way.
FeynRules is the most complete and user-friendly tool to implement and validate any new physics model.
we have provided a complete and consistent description of all the models, including all the Feynman rules and the corresponding matrix elements, as well as a full set of validation tests.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the FeynRules package can be used to automatically generate the full spectrum of a model and to provide the corresponding information to the event generators, thus allowing the generation of the most general set of processes for any given Lagrangian.

the combination of FeynRules and the other tools we use allows to generate the full matrix elements and decay widths of a model, including the full set of one-loop corrections, in a matter of minutes, without the need to write a single line of code.

a model-independent and fully automated framework is now available for any perturbative particle physics model, which will allow for a more efficient and accurate exploration of the parameter space of new physics scenarios, and will facilitate a better comparison of experimental data with theory predictions.
